content.text: Opea o sababuna manga lipu atobungke,
tee manga raʼeatina lipu ahaejatiaka parakara mosia-sia?
Manga rajana dunia sii apasiapuaka karona,
tee manga mokenina kuasa apomufakatimo
gauna aewangi KAWASANA OPU tee raja ipilina.
Pogauna manga incia,
"Mai tabhotukia o kabhokena KAWASANA OPU tee raja ipilina,
tee tabhanakea o rabutana manga incia minaaka i ingkita!"
Incia mokokauncuramakana i sorogaa apotawa,
Kawasana Opu aele-ele manga incia.
I wakutuu incia sumai Kawasana Opu bheafirimani i manga incia
tee apatokidha manga incia tee pamuruna,
"Iaku padhamo kulanti rajaku i Sion,
i gunuku momangkilona sumai."
Iaku bhekupogauaka opea mopadhana ipatotapuakana KAWASANA OPU.
Incia padhamo afirimaniaku, "Ingkoomo anaku,
i eo sii Iaku kupamembaliko anaku.
Emanimo i Iaku,
Sumaimo bhekudhawuakako manga lipu to amembali tinaurakamu,
tee saangua alamu kupamembalia pewauamu.
Ingkoo bheupahancuru manga incia tee katuko ase
tee upasakia manga mboomo poluka reo."
Rampaakanamo sumai, e manga raja,
pewaumo aarifu!
Tarimamo kaadhari, e manga mokuasaina dunia!
Sombamo i KAWASANA OPU tee umaekaia,
Rengkumo, tee upekatambe karomiu i aroana raja tee kaunde-unde.
Sombamo Incia tee kakatena totona incamu
mamudhaakana Incia inda apamuru tee apabinasakomiu i dhala
roonamo Incia amasimba mpuu aʼamara.
Amasanaamo bhari-bharia mia
mopeuluna i Incia!

footnotes.text: raja ipilina: Saro incia sii asusuaka to Isa Al Masi.
Sion: Saro kaabhi-abhina Kota Yerusalem, tampana Baitulla.
